title: Link All Zwischenbericht References as Hyperlinks and Citations
description: Make all cross-references (Anlage, Teil, Abschnitt) and literature references (vgl., BBSR-Online-Publikation) in mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex and zwischenbericht-dark.tex proper clickable hyperlinks and biblatex citations. Add \label targets for \part{Ergebnisse} and the Human-Interface-Design subsubsection, replace hardcoded "Teil~1" and "Abschnitt~1.2.3.2" with \hyperref refs, convert 11 manual "Anlage~\ref{...}" occurrences to use \appendixref (upgraded in semio-core.sty to wrap the whole phrase in \hyperref, not just the number), add a new references.bib entry for BBSR-Online-Publikation 61/2024 and cite it in place of the plain-text mention. Keep both tex variants line-identical and verify both PDFs build with no undefined references/citations.
summary: Made every cross-reference and literature mention in the Zwischenbericht a live hyperlink or biblatex citation. Upgraded \appendixref (print/tex/semio-core.sty) to wrap the whole "Anhang X" phrase in \hyperref instead of only the bare number, and converted all 11 manual "Anlage~\ref{...}" occurrences in both zwischenbericht.tex and zwischenbericht-dark.tex to use it (rendering as "Anhang", consistent with the appendix bodies' own self-referential wording — the report already used "Anhang" internally, so this fixes a pre-existing terminology inconsistency rather than introducing one). Added \label{teil:ergebnisse} on \part{Ergebnisse} and \label{abschnitt:human-interface-design} on the Human-Interface-Design subsubsection, then replaced the hardcoded "Teil~1" (zwischenbericht.tex) and "Abschnitt~1.2.3.2" (anhang/katalog.tex) with \hyperref-wrapped \ref* pointing at those labels. Added a new references.bib entry (bbsr-abbau-aufbau-2024, metadata verified against the BBSR publication page and DOI) and replaced the plain-text "(BBSR-Online-Publikation 61/2024)" mention with \cite{bbsr-abbau-aufbau-2024}. Left the external "Anlage~8 „Berichtswesen“" funding-contract reference and the existing \url{} untouched as they are not internal document elements. Verified both zwischenbericht.pdf and zwischenbericht-dark.pdf build cleanly (108 pages each, no undefined references/citations in either log) and confirmed via PDF annotation inspection (pypdf) that the new/changed links carry correct /GoTo destinations (part.1, subsubsection.1.2.3.2, part.appendix.*, cite.0@bbsr-abbau-aufbau-2024) and render identically in both theme variants. Hit an unrelated build failure mid-task caused by a concurrent session's in-progress edit to print/tex/semio-window.sty (transient "Undefined control sequence"); waited for that file's mtime to stabilize and rebuilt successfully — no changes made to that file.
